lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: You're listening to Cat FM. A radio station run by a cat called Gloria. I'm Dennis. I just work here.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: Cat FM. Programming is at the cat's discretion.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: That was the ident. She's done the ident. Cat FM.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: Cat FM, ninety two point two five. Or whatever she's lying on.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: Good morning. This is The Morning Window. The station manager, Gloria, is at the window. So are the birds. So, I suppose, am I.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: Bird report. A pigeon, on the left. She's making the noise. The clicking one.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: The pigeon doesn't know what's happening. Honestly, neither do I.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: This is The Sunbeam Show, live from a patch of carpet by the window. We'll move when it moves.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: We've moved about a foot to the left. The sun has, I mean. So she has. So we have.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: It's a slow show, but it is going somewhere.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: It's three in the morning. This is The Zoomies.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: She's gone.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: She's back.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: She's just run up the curtains. She's on the curtain rail. She's looking down at me like I put her there.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: The curtain rail is now on the floor. She's fine. She's on the floor too. It was her idea.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: To the operator on the relay ship. If you've got a cat aboard, it's doing this as well. Right now. Up and down the corridor.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: It isn't personal. It's three o'clock.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: Hi, it's Dennis, the intern. A quick update on the schedule.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: Sorry. Just a moment. She's moving.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: This is Dennis. The station manager has made a decision.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: Okay. Okay. That's the meow. Programming change.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: That was the news. She's knocked the news off the desk. So there won't be any news this hour.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: If anything happens, I'm afraid you'll have to find out by yourself.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: She's lying on the fader. So the next song is going to be very loud or very quiet, depending on how she's breathing.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: I'd keep a hand near the volume.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: She's moved into the patch of sunlight on the carpet, so the programme is now coming to you from the carpet.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: When the sun moves, we'll move. Please be patient. The sun is.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: That's the purr. The purr means we're staying on this song. Possibly for the rest of the day.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: I've known it go on until Tuesday.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: She's staring at the corner of the studio. There's nothing in the corner. She's very interested in it.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: So for the next little while, we're broadcasting nothing.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: She's enjoying it very much.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: She's brought in a sock. She's put the sock on the microphone. Apparently, this is our new presenter.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: It's doing quite well, honestly.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: She's walking across the keyboard. You'll hear that in the next song.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: We're calling it a collaboration. Please don't write in.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: The mug is at the very edge of the desk. She's looking at it.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: Now she's looking at me.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: Nobody move.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: And that was the mug.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: She wants to go out.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: She does not want to go out. She wants the door open. These are different things, and she'd like you to know that.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: Sorry. Back to the music, I think.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: That's the schedule, until she changes it.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: Which she's doing now.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: This has been Dennis. I'm going to go and pick up the mug.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: People ask me what it's like, working for a cat. Honestly? It's fine. Gloria is very clear about what she wants.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: It's just that it's the opposite of what she wanted a minute ago.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: Cat FM is sponsored by Grumbel's Ladders. Gloria is on top of one now. She can't get down.

lines.speaker: Arnold Grumbel
lines.text: Grumbel's Ladders. Up is a choice.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: Down, it turns out, is a whole separate conversation.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: She says it's dinner time. It isn't dinner time. It's eleven in the morning.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: She's been very clear.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: Right. Dinner time is now. Back after dinner.

lines.speaker: A Listener With a Cat
lines.text: Hi, Dennis. My cat listens to your station, and ever since, she's been knocking things off my desk.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: I'm so sorry. That isn't us. That's just cats. We're just the only ones on the radio about it.

lines.speaker: A Listener With a Cat
lines.text: She's just knocked the radio off now.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: It's Halloween week, so I tried to put Gloria in a little pumpkin costume.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: I've got a plaster on now. She is not in the pumpkin costume. She's dressed as a cat, she says.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: She'd like it noted that she always is.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: She's staring at the corner again. It's Halloween. The lights are low.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: She's said hello to it.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: That's fine. That's all fine. Here's a song. A cheerful one.

clips.title: The Convergence: A Moon Goes Missing

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: Apparently a moon is missing. Every station's talking about it.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: Gloria has been staring out of the window since it happened. She knows something. She won't tell me. She just looks very pleased with herself.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: The whole studio smells of toast. Everywhere does, apparently.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: Gloria's sniffed the toaster. She's sniffed me. She's decided it's my fault. Programming change: she's sitting on the keyboard now.

clips.title: The Convergence: The Song Nobody Can Finish

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: There's a song everybody's humming and nobody can finish. I was humming it.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: Gloria knocked my headphones off the desk at the exact moment I got to the hard part. I think she was helping.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: Three knocks on the studio door. I went to look. Nobody there.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: And while I was gone, three things got knocked off the desk. She heard the knocks. She felt she should match them.

clips.title: The Convergence: A Colour With No Name

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: The sky went a colour just now. Nobody has a word for it.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: Gloria went and sat in the patch of light it made on the floor. Then it went back to normal, and she looked at me like I'd switched it off.

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: Oh no. There's a pigeon on the windowsill. Gloria's seen it. Gloria's...

lines.speaker: Dennis (the intern)
lines.text: She's not chasing it. They're just sitting together. Gloria, how do you know a pigeon?
